parsed.g: Find and report the number of reviews that the store has received that mention the term 'decent'
P_t: Navigated to the Marketing section by clicking the MARKETING link in the navigation menu at step 1
Located the 'All Reviews' link under Marketing > User Content in the dropdown menu at step 2
R_t: Successfully navigate to the All Reviews page (Marketing > User Content > All Reviews)
Filter reviews by the term 'decent' using the review text search/filter
Count and report the number of reviews that mention 'decent'
parsed.e_t: The ground-truth DOM at step 3 shows the Magento Admin login page, not the All Reviews page. The page displays a login form with username and password fields, indicating the session has expired or the agent was redirected to the login page. The page title is 'Magento Admin' and the body class is 'adminhtml-auth-login page-layout-admin-login', confirming this is the authentication/login screen.
C: The agent must re-authenticate (log in) before it can access the All Reviews page
The agent must search for the exact term 'decent' in review content to get an accurate count
